runic_ascension.bloodline.burning_blood_: The blood carries ember-bright runes that flare under strain, strengthening the body through heat and violence. This lineage greatly increases maximum health and hints at future synergy with flame, violent, and backlash-heavy formulae.
A fierce bloodline marked by hot, aggressive script.
runic_ascension.bloodline.ink_blood_line: The blood runs dark with faint script, carrying qi through the body like ink across prepared paper. This lineage increases maximum qi and qi regeneration, making it well suited to repeated formula casting and long study of the Runic Path.
A bloodline that carries qi like living ink.
runic_ascension.inscription.clearflow.de: Water and heal are threaded through the body as a flowing recovery pattern. The inscription improves Water Mantle and later deepens restorative formulae.
A healing inscription that keeps the inner current clear.
runic_ascension.inscription.clearflow.ti: Further improves Water Mantle healing and grants a brief recovery pulse.
Greatly improves Water Mantle healing and strengthens restorative scripts.
runic_ascension.inscription.flameguard.d: Flame and guard are carved into the body as a sealed ember-script. The inscription dulls fire and later steadies flame formulae against backlash.
A defensive inscription that teaches the body to endure flame.
runic_ascension.inscription.flameguard.t: Further reduces fire damage and slightly softens flame backlash.
Greatly reduces fire damage and makes flame formulae easier to endure.
Mark, guard, and veil are arranged into a reactive script that watches for danger. The inscription subtly improves wards and may later reflect hostile traces.
A strange defensive inscription that remembers hostile intent.
Improves ward radius and prepares future reactive effects.
Greatly improves ward control and prepares future reflection effects.
runic_ascension.inscription.seal.missing: Hold the required material in your other hand: %s.
This inscription has reached its current limit.
runic_ascension.inscription.seal.tooltip: Used to carve known inscription patterns into the body.
Sneak and right-click to cycle the selected inscription.
runic_ascension.inscription.still_script: Stabilise and circle are carved as a closed pattern, forcing unstable strokes to move in harmony. The inscription reduces backlash and improves formula stability.
A stabilising inscription that quiets quarrelling formulae.
Reduces backlash and improves formula stability.
Greatly reduces backlash and steadies unstable formulae.
runic_ascension.inscription.stonehide.de: Earth and guard are pressed into the body as a dense protective script. The inscription strengthens Stone Ward and improves grounded defensive patterns.
A body inscription that roots defense into flesh and bone.
runic_ascension.inscription.stonehide.ti: Further empowers Stone Ward and improves its force.
Greatly empowers Stone Ward and strengthens defensive earth scripts.
runic_ascension.inscription.unlock.maxed: %s has already reached its current limit.
runic_ascension.inscription.unlock.missi: The pattern is incomplete. You are missing %s required rune(s).
runic_ascension.inscription.unlock.not_o: The script refuses your body. You have not entered the Runic Path.
runic_ascension.inscription.unlock.realm: Your Runic realm is too low. Requires Runic Realm %s.
runic_ascension.inscription.windstep.des: Wind and quicken are carved along the limbs, letting movement follow runic traces more easily. The inscription improves Trace Step and later adds brief speed after stepping.
A movement inscription that thins the body into a moving trace.
runic_ascension.inscription.windstep.tie: Increases Trace Step range and grants brief speed after stepping.
Greatly improves Trace Step and leaves only a faint trace behind.
runic_ascension.path.runic.description: A path of symbols, scripts, and living formulae that reveals the hidden language of reality.
runic_ascension.physiques.body_rune_phys: The skin, bones, and muscles respond naturally to inscription, as if the body were waiting to become a living talisman. This physique supports both the Body Path and the Runic Path, favouring defensive formulae, bodily inscriptions, and close-range endurance.
A physique where the flesh remembers protective script.
runic_ascension.physiques.essence_rune_p: Runic marks settle into the flow of essence, guiding qi through deliberate patterns. This physique supports both the Essence Path and the Runic Path, making it suitable for cultivators who shape formulae through breath, flow, and inner refinement.
A physique where runic traces mingle with essence circulation.
runic_ascension.physiques.etching_meridi: The meridians harden into channels of deliberate script, refining qi as it moves through the body. This evolution is aligned with the Runic and Essence Paths. Its deeper potential is currently sealed.
A sealed evolution focused on runic essence circulation.
runic_ascension.physiques.inscribing_bod: The body accepts runes as naturally as breath, turning flesh, bone, and meridian into a living scripture. This evolution is aligned with the Runic and Body Paths. Its deeper potential is currently sealed.
A sealed evolution focused on body-bound runic inscription.
The soul becomes a chamber of spoken glyphs, capable of calling script through intent alone. This evolution is aligned with the Runic and Soul Paths. Its deeper potential is currently sealed.
A sealed evolution focused on soul-bound runic invocation.
runic_ascension.physiques.runic_eyes.des: The pupils hold thin rings of living script, allowing the cultivator to perceive hidden strokes with unusual clarity. This physique greatly favours the Runic Path and is especially suited to discovery, observation, and formula study.
Eyes that read traces hidden beneath the surface of the world.
runic_ascension.physiques.runic_perfecti: Every breath, thought, and movement approaches the rhythm of a completed formula. The body no longer carries runes as markings; it begins to resemble a script written by reality itself. This evolution is currently sealed.
A sealed physique approaching pure runic harmony.
The body bears shallow traces of script, as if reality began writing and stopped before the final stroke. This physique grants a minor affinity for the Runic Path and may one day evolve toward soul, body, or meridian inscription.
A faintly marked physique with basic runic affinity.
runic_ascension.physiques.soul_rune_phys: Runic traces drift through the soul like lanterns under dark water, sharpening perception and deepening symbolic control. This physique supports both the Soul Path and the Runic Path, favouring observation, invocation, and inner script manipulation.
A physique where the soul echoes with half-formed glyphs.
runic_ascension.runic.brush.tooltip.basi: A steady beginner brush that slightly softens cost and backlash.
runic_ascension.runic.brush.tooltip.eart: A grounded brush that steadies barriers and enduring scripts.
runic_ascension.runic.brush.tooltip.heav: A precise brush that thins qi cost and lengthens clean formulae.
runic_ascension.runic.brush.tooltip.hell: A hungry brush that deepens power while inviting harsher backlash.

runic_ascension.runic.cast.failure: The runes scatter like forgotten names.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.formula_too_c: The script frays beyond the measure of your inner sea.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.missing_core_: A source must breathe, and an intent must guide it.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.no_usable_run: You do not know any usable runes.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.not_enough_qi: Your qi thins before the final stroke can be sealed.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.not_on_path: You have not entered the Runic Path.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.rune_beyond_c: A rune slips past your grasp, its meaning still veiled.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.runes_do_not_: The runes refuse to share the same truth.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.too_many_form: Too many vessels twist the formula from shape into ruin.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.too_many_inte: Too many wills pull the script into contradiction.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.too_many_sour: Too many origins awaken, each claiming the first breath.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.unstable_form: The trembling script breaks, and backlash answers.
The formula trembles beneath your will, but obeys.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.unstable_modi: The lesser strokes quarrel, and the formula begins to shudder.
runic_ascension.runic.cast.unstable_open: A stray stroke opens the rite, and the script loses its root.
runic_ascension.runic.casting.empty.line: You do not know any usable runes yet.
Study a Runic Tome to awaken your first script.

runic_ascension.runic.codex.scrap_hint.r: Rune notes will help explain origins, intent, forms, and modifiers.
runic_ascension.runic.codex.scrap_hint.s: Sequence notes will help explain formula safety, mastery, and suppression.

runic_ascension.runic.scrap.already_reco: %s is already recorded in your Codex.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.first_formul: Flame awakens. Cut gives hunger. Bolt gives path.
Together they become a wound written in fire.
Change bolt to line, and the wound becomes a drawn edge.
Add violent, and power rises while stability falls.
A first formula is not the answer, only a door.
A Scrap Bearing a Simple Formula
A worn hint toward a beginner formula.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.line_1: Form gives a formula its vessel.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.line_2: Bolt flies, line draws, wall stands, circle surrounds.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.line_3: The same origin and intent may change greatly by shape.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.line_4: A wise hand chooses the vessel before releasing the truth.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.title: A Brittle Scrap on Forms
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.toolti: A torn lesson about giving formulae a body.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.free_casting: Recorded sequences are safe roads worn by older hands.
Free formulae are roads written as you walk.
Learn origins, wills, vessels and strokes, then test their grammar.
When enough runes answer you, the Codex becomes a map instead of a cage.
A Half-Remembered Scrap on Free Casting
A torn lesson about writing beyond memorised sequences.
Violence, haste, depth and poor order all invite backlash.
Stabilising strokes can quiet the quarrel, but may soften the result.
A reckless rune master writes with blood when ink runs thin.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.intent.line_: Intent is the desire carved into a sleeping origin.
Cut divides, guard preserves, bind restrains, heal restores.
Without intent, power pools like rain in an unmarked bowl.
With intent, the rune remembers what it must become.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.intent.title: A Brittle Scrap on Intent
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.intent.toolt: A torn lesson about giving power a will.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.modifiers.li: Modifiers are lesser strokes, but lesser does not mean weak.
Quicken hastens, stabilise steadies, heavy burdens, violent wounds.
A modifier before the root makes the script stumble.
Place the root first, then refine what it becomes.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.modifiers.ti: A Brittle Scrap on Lesser Strokes
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.modifiers.to: A torn lesson about modifiers and finishing strokes.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.origin.line_: A formula begins where power takes its first breath.
Flame, wind, earth, life and their kin are origins.
An origin alone only wakes. It does not yet choose.
Pair it with intent, and the script begins to move.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.origin.title: A Brittle Scrap on Origins
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.origin.toolt: A torn lesson about where formulae begin.
A higher script need not always descend in full.
Suppress the realm of a formula to spare qi and narrow its reach.
A small flame may light a path where a great one burns the forest.
Mastery teaches the hand how much truth to reveal.
A folded lesson about holding back a formula.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.tooltip.read: Right-click to let the words settle in your mind.

runic_ascension.skill.cinder_brand.descr: Marks a target with burning script. Requires the Flame, Mark, and Release runes.
runic_ascension.skill.open_runic_casting: Open the Runic Casting interface and weave known runes into a sequence.
runic_ascension.skill.runic_sight.descri: Opens the inner eye to glimpse runes hidden in nearby blocks and traces.
runic_ascension.skill.script_sever.descr: Draws a thin cutting line through a target. Requires the Cut and Line runes.
runic_ascension.skill.stone_ward.descrip: Sustains a defensive stone ward while held, consuming qi over time. The ward pushes nearby enemies back and disrupts incoming projectiles. Requires the Earth and Guard runes.
runic_ascension.skill.trace_step.descrip: Steps through a thin wind-veiled trace. Range increases with Runic realm. Requires the Wind and Veil runes.
runic_ascension.skill.water_mantle.descr: Wraps the caster in flowing script while held, consuming qi over time. The mantle extinguishes flame, mends wounds, and dampens incoming force. Requires the Water and Heal runes.
runic_ascension.technique.inner_inscript: A Runic Path technique that turns the body into a vessel for stable script. It favours vitality, endurance, defensive wards, and future body inscription effects.
A defensive runic technique focused on the body and inscriptions.
runic_ascension.technique.outer_formula_: A Runic Path technique that writes command into the world rather than the body. It favours intelligence, offensive formulae, ranged scriptwork, and future external rune manipulation.
An offensive runic technique focused on external formulae.
runic_ascension.technique.runic_apprenti: A foundational runic technique that teaches the cultivator to perceive traces, arrange symbols, and begin shaping formulae through the Runic Path.
A beginner technique for sensing and shaping runic traces.
runic_ascension.technique.trace_visualiz: A Runic Path technique that sharpens the inner eye and follows hidden traces through the world. It favours intelligence, agility, Runic Sight, Trace Step, and future discovery-based progression.
A perception-focused runic technique for sight, movement, and discovery.
